name: message-thread-reveal
title: Message Thread Reveal
description: A full text conversation plays out on a phone - bubbles popping in, typing indicators, a shared link card, emoji, delivered receipts - with the whole thread scrolling up beat by beat until a closing card lands. The complete chat ad-template, measured message by message
author: Miao Yang

variables.label: Contact name
variables.description: Name pill in the chat header; the avatar shows its first letter.

variables.label: Opening question
variables.description: First incoming message that establishes what the conversation is about.
variables.default: what r u using for the launch video??

variables.label: Teaser reply
variables.description: First typed outgoing reply before the shared link card.

variables.label: Link card image
variables.description: Preview image on the shared link card.

variables.label: Link card title
variables.description: Title of the shared link card. It leads with the real name of the brand this video promotes.
variables.default: HyperFrames | Write HTML, render pixel-perfect video

variables.label: Link card domain
variables.description: Domain of the brand this video promotes, under the card title. Use the real domain.

variables.label: Link reaction
variables.description: Incoming reaction immediately after the shared link.

variables.label: Reaction emoji
variables.description: Emoji-only reaction after the shared link.

variables.label: Benefit reply
variables.description: Typed outgoing reply that names the primary benefit.

variables.label: Discovery question
variables.description: Incoming question asking where the product was found.

variables.label: Source reply
variables.description: Typed outgoing reply naming where to find the brand this video promotes.

variables.label: Workflow reply
variables.description: Typed outgoing reply describing how the product works.
variables.default: u just write plain html tags

variables.label: Ownership reply
variables.description: Typed outgoing reply that closes the product explanation.

variables.label: Intent reply
variables.description: Incoming message expressing intent to try the product.

variables.label: Closing reply
variables.description: Final incoming message in the conversation.

variables.label: Brand logo
variables.description: Transparent horizontal wordmark of the brand this video promotes, on the closing card.

variables.label: End-card proof
variables.description: Social-proof line under the stars. Claim only a figure the brand itself publishes; use neutral copy when there is none.

variables.label: End-card feature 1
variables.description: First two-line benefit; use | to break the line.

variables.label: End-card feature 2
variables.description: Second two-line benefit; use | to break the line.

variables.label: End-card feature 3
variables.description: Third two-line benefit; use | to break the line.

variables.label: End-card CTA
variables.description: Label on the closing card button.
